annotations.title: Water or fuel quantity in jerry cans

description:
Work out how much water or fuel to hold, with a margin, and how many jerry cans and 20 ft containers that takes.
Use when: planning an emergency water store, or fuel for a trip, boat, generator or machinery. Instead: un_number_packaging for transport rules.
Water (the default): people times days times the scenario's litres a person a day: relief 15 (Sphere minimum, the default), acute 7.5, protracted 50, survival 3, nl, se and dk 3, no 2.86, fi and de 2, or custom with rate. National scenarios supply a household of 4 and their own days when those are left out.
Fuel (mode=fuel, or any fuel input): road and overland work from distance and consumption, overland counting the way back with returnTrip=1; marine, agri and generator from hours and consumption, generator also from kva and load; hours or kva with no scenario selects generator. units=us switches to miles, mpg and US gallons.
Either mode: volume with no scenario is the amount to hold. reserve sets the margin, by default 10% for water and 0 to 50% by fuel scenario.
Returns: working, base_l, margin_pct, total_l, the can size, cans and containers_20ft.
Behaviour: read-only; the same inputs give the same answer. A missing people, days, distance or hours returns ok:false naming it, never a demo figure; a defaulted consumption is noted in assumed.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.
The can is a Fortitude21 product, named with its link, and each answer carries publisher with a quote_url.

can.description: Optional product slug of the can to size in, e.g. product-20l-nato-steel-fuel-can. Default: the scenario's usual can

consumption.description: Fuel: L/100 km for road and overland, L/h for marine, agri and generator; with units=us, miles per US gallon or US gallons an hour. Defaults noted in assumed

days.description: Water: days to cover. Required unless the scenario sets it

distance.description: Fuel, road and overland: trip distance in km (miles with units=us). Required for those scenarios

hours.description: Fuel, marine, agri and generator: running hours to cover. Required for those scenarios

kva.description: Fuel, generator: rating in kVA, used with load instead of consumption

load.description: Fuel, generator: load in per cent, with kva

mode.description: water (default) or fuel. Set to fuel when distance, hours, kva or consumption is given

people.description: Water: people to supply. Required unless a national scenario sets a household of 4

rate.description: Water, custom scenario: litres a person a day

reserve.description: Margin in per cent added to the base volume

returnTrip.description: Fuel, overland: 1 to count the return leg

scenario.description: Water: relief (default), acute, protracted, survival, nl, se, no, fi, dk, de, custom. Fuel: road (default), overland, marine, generator, agri, direct

units.description: metric (default) or us for miles, mpg and US gallons

units_n.description: Fuel: number of vehicles, boats or machines (default 1)

volume.description: Litres (US gallons with units=us) to hold. With no scenario it replaces the calculation in either mode

weeks.description: Weeks to cover, converted to days when days is not given

name: jerry_can_quantity

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

containers_20ft.description: Share of a 20 ft container, or null where no load figure exists

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

needs.description: When ok is false: the inputs still needed

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

scenario.description: id and label of the scenario, and its rate for water

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Water or fuel quantity in jerry cans
